## Connecting AI assistants to your Gumroad store

In this article:

- What the Gumroad connector is
- Which assistants you can connect
- Connecting Claude
- Connecting ChatGPT
- What your assistant can do
- What your assistant cannot do
- What you are granting access to
- Revoking access
- Troubleshooting

### What the Gumroad connector is

Gumroad runs a server that speaks MCP (Model Context Protocol), so an AI assistant that supports MCP can work with your store from your chat. You connect your Gumroad account once, sign in through Gumroad, and then you can ask the assistant things like "show my recent sales" or "draft a product called Photo Pack for $12".

Nothing about your store changes. Products, customers, sales, and payouts all stay in Gumroad, and customers still pay through Gumroad checkout. The connector is a way to read your store's data and make a few changes from chat instead of from your dashboard.

### Which assistants you can connect

- **Claude:** available now in [Claude's connector directory](https://claude.ai/directory/gumroad). You can also add it as a custom connector.
- **Muse:** submitted for review. The Gumroad connector is not yet available in Muse.
- **ChatGPT:** available now in [ChatGPT's plugin directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6adf8e8e7eac8191a9af1b87fdeedb45).
Setup instructions for every assistant we support are also at [gumroad.com/mcp](https://gumroad.com/mcp).

### Connecting Claude

1. Open [Gumroad in Claude's connector directory](https://claude.ai/directory/gumroad) and connect it. You need to be signed in to Claude.
2. When Claude opens a Gumroad sign-in page, sign in and review the permissions you are asked to grant.
3. In a chat, select the Gumroad connector and try asking "Show my Gumroad products."
Gumroad is listed as a community connector, so Claude shows a notice that Anthropic has not verified it. The connector is run by Gumroad.

You can also add Gumroad as a custom connector: in Claude, open **Settings > Connectors**, choose **Add custom connector**, and paste this URL: `https://gumroad.com/claude/v1/mcp`. Custom connectors depend on your Claude plan and your organization's settings.

Your assistant sees the Gumroad account selected in the account switcher when you connect. To work with another account you administer, switch to it first, then connect.

### Connecting ChatGPT

1. Open [Gumroad in ChatGPT's plugin directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6adf8e8e7eac8191a9af1b87fdeedb45) and connect it. You need to be signed in to ChatGPT.
2. When ChatGPT opens a Gumroad sign-in page, sign in and review the permissions you are asked to grant.
3. In a chat, with the Gumroad plugin enabled, try asking "Show my Gumroad products."
Your assistant sees the Gumroad account selected in the account switcher when you connect. To work with another account you administer, switch to it first, then connect.

### What your assistant can do

- Read your name, username, storefront URL, and currency.
- List your products, newest first, with their prices, including pay-what-you-want minimum and suggested prices.
- Read a single product's description, summary, additional details and tags and, with sales access, its sales count and revenue.
- Create a new product as an unpublished draft.
- Change the name, description, summary, additional details, tags, price, or URL of a product you own. The old URL keeps working. A membership with tiers keeps its tier prices.
- Add a cover image to a product from a public link to the image, or a YouTube or Vimeo video link.
- Add the files a buyer receives to a product from a public link to each file, and list the files already attached.
- Add a link buyers open after purchase, shown on the product's content page as a button whose text you choose.
- Publish or unpublish a product you own.
- List your recent sales, including the buyer's email address, the product, the amount, and the time.
- List your recent payouts and their status.
A file added from chat is copied into your product, up to 250 MB per file. Check the name, price, description, files, and links before you publish anything.

### What your assistant cannot do

- Take a payment or run checkout. Customers always pay through Gumroad.
- Add a file larger than 250 MB, or add a file or image you attach in the chat. Files and covers need a public link; a large video has to be uploaded in Gumroad.
- Refund a sale, or change your payout destination or payout schedule.
- Delete a product.
Anything outside that list, do in your Gumroad dashboard.

The connector asks for permission for the specific things it needs. You can grant some and not others:

- **Public profile** and **profile**: your name, username, and storefront basics.
- **Products**: read your products, create drafts, edit them, add covers and files, and publish or unpublish them.
- **Sales**: read your recent sales, including buyer email addresses.
- **Payouts**: read your payout amounts and status.
- **Account**: full access to your account, which is wider than the connector needs.
Sales access means the assistant can read your customers' email addresses, so grant it only if you are comfortable with that. If you deny a permission, the assistant simply cannot use the tools that need it and will say which one it is missing.

### Revoking access

Revoke the connection any time under [Authorized Applications](https://gumroad.com/settings/authorized_applications) in your Gumroad settings. Disconnecting or deleting the connector inside your AI app does not revoke its access token, so revoke it in Gumroad to actually end the connection.

### Troubleshooting

**I cannot add Gumroad in Claude.** Start from [Gumroad's directory listing](https://claude.ai/directory/gumroad) while signed in to Claude. On Team and Enterprise plans, your organization's settings control which connectors you can add, so an administrator may need to allow it.

**I cannot add Gumroad in ChatGPT.** Start from [Gumroad's plugin listing](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6adf8e8e7eac8191a9af1b87fdeedb45) while signed in to ChatGPT. If you use a workspace, an administrator may need to allow the plugin.

**The assistant says it cannot find my products.** Check that you connected the Gumroad account that owns them, and that you granted product access during sign-in. If you connected the wrong account, revoke access and connect again.

**A tool says it needs a permission.** Reconnect the assistant and grant the permission it names. Nothing else changes when you do.

**Publishing from chat fails.** Publishing needs the same things it needs in your dashboard: a confirmed email address, payouts set up for your account, and shipping destinations if you sell physical products. A product that Gumroad has taken down also cannot be published. Fix that in Gumroad, then ask the assistant to publish again.

**The assistant created a draft I cannot sell.** Drafts start with no files. Add your files to the product in Gumroad, then publish it there or ask the assistant to publish it.

If something else is not working, email [support@gumroad.com](mailto:support@gumroad.com) and tell us which assistant you connected.
